tables.name: TimedSignalMapEntry
documentation: Structure associating a key with a scheduled time.

fields.name: key
documentation: The key that has been scheduled.

fields.name: time
documentation: Absolute time, on the same clock as GetTime(), at which the key is scheduled to signal.

tables.name: TimedSignalMapCallback
documentation: Invoked by a timed signal map when a scheduled time has arrived.

Arguments.Name: key
Documentation: The key whose scheduled time has arrived; secret if the timed signal map has secret values.

predicates.Name: RequiresTimedSignalMapAccess
Documentation: Guarded APIs on a timed signal map raise an error when the map holds secret values and is accessed from a tainted execution context.
